data.title: City Park and Playground
data.summary: 40 stylized city park models: modular path, lawn, safety surfacing and fencing, swings, a slide, a play tower, a climbing frame, monkey bars, a roundabout, a seesaw, spring rockers, a bandstand, a kiosk, benches, lamps, trees and a duck pond, in one assembled park corner.
data.description: Everything needed to build a city park with a children's playground in it. The ground tiles on a 2 m and 4 m grid with real connector ports: path straights and quarter turns, mown lawn modules, rubber safety surfacing in red and blue, clipped hedge runs and an eight piece duck pond that closes into a ring. The play area is a two bay swing set with flat or toddler seats, a slide tower, a roofed play tower, a climbing frame, monkey bars, a rope net climber, a roundabout, a seesaw, three spring rockers, a sandpit and the bow top fencing, gate and rules sign that close it off. The park around it carries benches, picnic tables, timber bins, a drinking fountain, lamp posts, bollards, a notice board, a bike rack, a dog waste bin, flower beds, two tree shapes, shrubs, a pergola, a hexagonal bandstand, a refreshment kiosk and a piered entrance gate. Clips are rigid node transforms only: the swing seats swing from the top bar, the seesaw tips on its axle, the rockers rock above their springs, the roundabout spins, the gates open and close, the bin lid lifts and the kiosk shutter lifts out. The rope net, the swing hanger rods and the spring coils are modelled solid and stated as static, because each needs a joint per element that a rigid node cannot give. Original AI-generated CC0 geometry, prepared for human review. No physics, gameplay, colliders, navigation or embedded lights.

starterScene.description: A 28 x 22 m corner of a city park: a fenced playground laid on red and blue rubber safety tiles with swings, a slide, a play tower, a climbing frame, monkey bars, a rope net, a roundabout, a seesaw, a sandpit and three spring rockers inside it, and a gate onto a paved apron with a notice board and a bike rack.
